root_cause: CladeGuard.swift was hand-written rollback/health code with no T27 spec or provenance, violating L2 GENERATION. The existing clade-guard.md spec existed but had no active claim, task, or seal artifacts.
fix_pattern: Updated clade-guard.md spec with full invariants, interface, decision flow, and tests. Acquired claim CLADEGUARD-001. t27-creator added T27-CANON header, aligned docs, removed /dev/null fallback, and added tests/swift/clade_guard_test.swift for verifyChecksum. Build was blocked by unrelated untracked mesh-chat files (MeshChatModels Character Codable error + MeshTabView extra brace); triaged with AGENT-V-WAIVER blocks and ownership-index entries. Verifier re-issued CLEAN verdict; seal written.
lessons: A single pre-existing build error in an unrelated untracked file blocks the entire L4 gate for every T27 seal.
Use AGENT-V-WAIVER with an expiry to triage files that are not part of the current wave, then create ownership-index entries so clade-audit --canon sees them.
Fix the literal build error too if it is trivial (extra brace) so the wave can proceed; leave deeper semantic fixes for a follow-up issue.
Keep claims refreshed before verifier runs; stale claims turn CLEAN implementations into NEEDS_FIX.
